h: Agbese rejects Kingibe's claim of a 25% fuel levy as false
p: Agbese has reportedly hit back at Kingibe, calling his allegation of a 25% levy on fuel a fabrication. The exchange adds to the growing war of words ahead of the 2027 polls.
more: No official figures on the alleged levy have been published.
Both sides are expected to keep trading claims as campaigns heat up.
